## Security Policy

### Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `main` (latest) | ✅ Yes |
| Older releases | ❌ No |

### Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do NOT open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

If you discover a security vulnerability in GlobalTalk AI, please report it responsibly by emailing:

📧 **[security@globaltalk.ai](mailto:security@globaltalk.ai)**

Include in your report:
- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce it
- The potential impact
- Any suggested remediation (if known)

We will acknowledge your report within **48 hours** and aim to resolve confirmed vulnerabilities within **14 days**.

We follow a **Coordinated Disclosure** policy — we will coordinate with you before any public disclosure.
